raw_files.title: UK DESNZ 2026 conversion factors, revised flat format
Monash Car Parts dataset with missing values, version 2

corporate_data_status: Bounded search found public business descriptions and aggregate disclosures, but no directly downloadable joint SKU demand/inventory/lead-time/freight-price panel for the reviewed firms. This does not establish that such public data never exist.
warehouse_emissions_status: No verified warehouse energy or CO2e-per-unit-week company data. Root scenario coefficient 0.04 kgCO2e per unit-week, if used, is an unverified experimental assumption, not an EMA or company measurement.

sea_routes.interpretation: Historical published corridor geometry/delay evidence used for scenario design. Not a live 2026 sailing schedule or company-specific route record.

validation_notes: Do not infer SKU demand, shipment weights, freight tariffs, or service costs from annual-report totals.
Public car-parts demand is a real analogue, not a semiconductor dataset; its original monthly frequency must be retained or any resampling explicitly labelled synthetic.
ASML cargo damage excluded by user instruction; no loss/damage scenario should be attributed to source company.
